newsitem.title: USA: Intl FiberCom wins contracts for $4.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Intl FiberCom wins contracts for $4.1 mln.

text.p: International FiberCom Inc on Monday said its unit, Kleven Construction Inc, has won several contracts valued at a total $4.1 million over their life.
The company signed two utility contracts with the City of Phoenix Water Department for over $3.75 million, or roughly $1.25 million for each of the next three years.

International FiberCom also said it won three additional contracts for its power division with the Salt River Project, totalling $400,000. Work is expected to be completed by the third quarter's end. The contracts are in addition to previously announced work with the Salt River Project.
